reason: I do 1-6 homes a year and my clients come with an architect who already does the plans. My buyers have never asked to see a home before it's built, so I wouldn't pay for it out of my own pocket.
objection: I wouldn't pay for it; the homeowner would have to agree to it. It's not something my clients ask for, and $1,500 a home on a handful of homes is money for a problem I don't have.
would_change_my_mind: If my clients or their architects started asking to see the home before construction, or the homeowner agreed to pay for it as a line item.
